text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ardan conquered the Kikuka-sho, yet 
the lingering sensation of the immense 
pressure Super Creek unleashed left her 
thrilled.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There were countless rivals to whom she 
could devote her entire heart and soul. As 
long as they were there, her growth would 
know no bounds—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With this newfound realization, Mejiro 
Ardan felt her heart flutter with 
excitement toward her next goal.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At the same time, Sakura Chiyono O was 
watching the Kikuka Sho on TV, witnessing 
Mejiro Ardan's growth firsthand.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ardan steps forward toward the 
Osaka Hai. However, she has no way of 
knowing about the shadow that fell across 
Sakura Chiyono O's face...
